jira_draft.title: Fix case-insensitive Idempotency-Key handling and enforce mutex lock before debit
jira_draft.description: Lowercase header idempotency-key bypassed the idempotency filter and absence of distributed mutex lock allowed concurrent double debit.
repro_steps: Submit two concurrent POST /api/transfers requests with header "idempotency-key: test-key"
Observe both debits succeed without 409 conflict
